name: Conciseness rescue for zero-variance groups
tagline: Pass rewards through unchanged for mixed groups; for all-correct groups give a small bonus to shorter responses, for all-wrong groups penalize longer ones (length-normalized in [0,1]).

key_hyperparams.name: conciseness_bonus
key_hyperparams.role: max bonus/penalty injected into zero-variance groups

init_recovers: outcome_only baseline when no group is zero-variance
diff_from_baseline: Strict superset of the outcome_only baseline: only intervenes on prompt-groups where GRPO would emit zero gradient (all-correct or all-wrong), and breaks the tie with a length-based bonus/penalty bounded by 0.25.

name: Thresholded min-max conciseness penalty
tagline: Penalize positively-rewarded responses that exceed the per-group minimum length by more than a 128-token margin, with linear ramp normalised to the group's max excess.

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: max penalty fraction of positive reward

key_hyperparams.name: margin
key_hyperparams.role: length threshold (tokens) before penalty kicks in

init_recovers: outcome_only when length differences within a group are ≤ 128 tokens or all rewards ≤ 0
diff_from_baseline: Asymmetric length-aware penalty applied per-group: instead of dividing every reward by sqrt(L) like the length_aware baseline, it only shrinks positive rewards of responses that overshoot the group's shortest answer by 128+ tokens.

name: Rank-Calibrated Group-Length Norm (RCGLN)
tagline: Sqrt-length normalize per response, then within each prompt-group convert to a centered tied-average rank in [-1,1] scaled by an IQR/MAD separation factor, then batch-whiten.

key_hyperparams.name: margin_floor
key_hyperparams.role: minimum margin even for flat (binary) groups

key_hyperparams.name: sep_weight
key_hyperparams.role: weight on IQR/MAD separation in margin formula

init_recovers: centered tied-rank only (no IQR/MAD) when sep = 0; pure rank-norm behaviour
diff_from_baseline: Replaces both batch_std and group_std baselines with a within-group rank statistic plus an IQR/MAD-based margin and a final batch whitening; far more aggressive geometry change than length_aware.

name: ALCN: log-length + percentile-clip + median-MAD
tagline: Divide each reward by log(1+L), clip at the 5th/95th percentile of the batch, then center on the batch median and divide by 1.4826*MAD.
init_recovers: length_aware-style scaling when MAD scaling and percentile clip are saturated
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the batch_std baseline's mean/std whitening with a robust median-MAD whitening on top of a log-length divisor and a percentile clipper, keeping the same last-valid-token placement.

name: Length-normalized batch whitening (LNBW)
tagline: First divide each scalar reward by sqrt(response_length), then z-score across the entire batch (mean/std).
init_recovers: batch_std baseline at length_power = 0; length_aware baseline at length_power = 0.5 without whitening
diff_from_baseline: Composes the length_aware (sqrt-L) and batch_std baselines into a single hook: sqrt-length divide first, then mean/std batch whitening, before placing the scalar at the last valid token.
